title: CauldronHUD
description: Look at a cauldron and a small HUD shows what it holds and how full it is (Water/Lava/Powder Snow, level 0-3).
body:
**CauldronHUD** is a clean look-at info layer. Point your crosshair at any **cauldron** and a small readout appears in the **top-left** of your screen telling you exactly what it holds and how full it is:

- **Empty** — a plain cauldron, nothing inside
- **Water 1–3 / 3** — a water cauldron and its current fill level
- **Powder Snow 1–3 / 3** — a powder snow cauldron and its level
- **Lava (full)** — a lava cauldron

### Why

Vanilla only hints at a cauldron's contents through a small texture change inside the block, and the exact fill level is hard to read at a glance — especially from a distance or across a row of cauldrons. CauldronHUD puts the precise content and level on screen so you always know whether a dyeing/leather-washing station, a powder snow trap, or a water/lava store is ready to use, without dipping a bucket or walking right up to it.

### Details

- Pure client-side info HUD — reads the cauldron's vanilla block state only. No mixins, no block entities, no gameplay changes.
- Toggle the HUD on/off with **U**.
- Works on Minecraft **1.21.8 – 1.21.11** (Fabric).
